phases.name: Phase 0 — Contract reconciliation and red baseline
phases.note: Independent review rejected the exit gate: night fixture is not same-D across injected midnight, and mandatory creation/restore/consumer/group failure baselines lack executed test evidence.

phases.name: Phase 1V — Pure valuation contract, time and replay correctness
phases.note: Typed structured boundary, readiness/publication, validated decoding, direct replay for old/new readers, DST/IANA, cross-TZ/market regressions and revision inventory passed 38/38; independent findings resolved.

phases.name: Phase 2V — Unified FX and market resolver
phases.note: Structured aggregate and unified resolver passed the fresh 98/98 focused gate; all independent-review findings were resolved and the independent verdict is ACCEPT. Legacy bare totalAt remains quarantined outside this exit scope until Phase 4 cutover.

phases.name: Phase 3V — Minimal V7 close repository
phases.note: V7 close repository, byte-pinned accepted V6 fixture, backup/restore, deterministic concurrency, durable readiness/rebuild and transactional revision writers passed the combined and focused gates; independent P1 review is green.

phases.name: Phase 1P — Product identity, catalog and atomic factory
phases.note: Typed product catalog and atomic factory are wired through production UI, QuickSetup, bulk, seeding and legacy conversion; real V5→V6→V7 fixtures and the combined gate passed, with independent P0/P1 review green.

phases.name: Phase 4 — Portfolio producer, lazy close and shadow consumers
phases.note: Dynamics, dashboard, overview and Cashflow consume the structured portfolio producer; legacy predecessor coverage is explicit and exactly-once, incomplete coverage fails closed, repository reads recheck live readiness, and batched valuation avoids the former N+1 replay. After a real-device screenshot reproduced a 23,147,393 RUB silent-drop delta, the no-override shipping default was switched from shadow to the cache-only structured reader. Explicit shadow and structured compatibility rollback remain. Expanded cutover gate: 58/58 (/tmp/millio-emergency-cutover-expanded.xcresult).

phases.name: Phase 5 — Backfill, observation and cutover
phases.note: Emergency structured reader remains active. Exact-date cache-first FX/market backfill now renders the real-device 1W chart; CBR is primary for RUB pairs, incomplete results remain fail-closed, and the former manifest/revision/RUB-fetch failures are absent from the acceptance log. Historical arithmetic is internally exact: 98,898,259 + 958,897 = 99,857,156 across Dynamics and Cashflow. The 110,156 RUB difference from the 99,967,312 live balance is explicitly classified as live-versus-historical-close basis, not silently reconciled. Focused simulator suites, including the repaired grouped legacy migration cases, pass. The 30-observation/7-day policy, offline transition, rollback drill, and backend publication remain open.

phases.name: Phase 6 — Cleanup and documentation
phases.note: Do not delete shadow/compatibility readers before Phase 5 approval and the real rollback window. Cleanup inventory is prepared; architecture/currency/schema/backup documentation and final deletion remain deferred.
